title: Qualify the artifact, not just the ideas
summary: A sphere is not done when its prose looks right. Validate structure, lint authoring quality, run executable tests, activate/query the sphere through Gopher, record qualification evidence and package only the qualified tree. Material doctrine/classification changes are versioned.
evidence_note: The sibling spheres were each qualified by installing into the engine distribution, running tests/run_<id>.sh, then sphere resolve FOUND / sphere load ACTIVATED in a fresh env and confirming the active external profile served the expected article set before the ZIP was dropped under current/sphere/.
invariants: Run `sphere edit validate` and address structural breaches.
Use `sphere edit lint` as advisory authoring-quality evidence; do not confuse lint with semantic truth.
Run the sphere's own tests and exercise context/open/search/lookup or advertised capabilities through the engine.
Record qualification and version material changes before packaging.
Package the exact qualified tree with a manifest.
